changeSet.author: Pappas
changeSet.sql: create or alter function [dbo].[GetAssetScoreById] ( @Id bigint, @scoreType int ) RETURNS TABLE AS RETURN ( select top 1 S.RunDate, S.EffectiveDate, S.[Value], case when S.Value is null then ' ' else cast(cast((S.[Value] * 100) as float) as nvarchar) + '%' end as FormattedValue from metrics.Score S inner join Asset A on A.[uid] = S.AssetUid and A.Id = @Id and S.EndDate is null inner join metrics.Allocation Al on Al.Uid = S.AllocationUid and Al.ScoreType = @scoreType and Al.OverrideName is null )
changeSet.rollback: CREATE OR ALTER FUNCTION [dbo].[GetAssetScoreById] ( @Id bigint, @scoreType int ) RETURNS TABLE AS RETURN ( select S.RunDate, S.EffectiveDate, S.[Value], case when S.Value is null then ' ' else cast(cast((S.[Value] * 100) as float) as nvarchar) + '%' end as FormattedValue from metrics.Score S inner join Asset A on A.[uid] = S.AssetUid inner join AssetType T on T.ID = A.AssetTypeID where A.Id = @Id and S.ScoreType = @scoreType and S.EndDate is null )
